title: lomatia hirsuta
intro: Lomatia hirsuta, commonly known as Matricaria hirsuta or False chamomile, is a plant species in the daisy family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Lomatia hirsuta include its ability to induce relaxation and improve sleep quality, likely due to its bioactive constituents such as essential oils and flavonoids. However, the bioactive constituents of Lomatia hirsuta are not fully understood, and more research is needed to determine its full therapeutic potential.
